about.title: Ukwakha Iinsombululo Zedijithali Ezithuthukisa Amabhizinisi Phambili
about.description:
I-Oklut Technologies yinkampani yezisombululo zethekhnoloji edzimelele ekusizeni amabhizinisi ukutjhugulula imibono ibe zizinto ezizwakalako zedijithali. Sihlanganisa ithekhnoloji, ukusungula, nokuzwisisa ibhizinisi ukuletha iinsombululo eziklanywe ngokuya ngeendingo zephasi lamambala.

Kusukela ekuguqulweni kwedijithali nokuthuthukiswa kwesofthiwe ekhethekileko ukuya emafini, i-AI, ukuzenzekelayo, kanye nemisebenzi yethekhnoloji elawulwako, sisiza iinhlangano ukwenza lula ubudisi, ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kuhle, nokwakha inani ledijithali elihlala njalo. yakha ithekhnoloji eletha.
about.awardText: Iqakathekiswa ngokuletha okuhle khulu kibo boke ubunjiniyela bemikhiqizo yewebhu neyeselula.
about.staffText: Onjiniyela abakhulu, abaziphendulelako abaphethe umsebenzi kusukela ekuthomeni ukuya ekuthomeni.
about.supportText: Iinkonzo ezilawulwako kanye nomlayini wokusekela ophendulako lokha nawuwutlhogako.

insights.sub: Ukuhlola imibono, imikghwa, kanye nethekhnoloji ebumba ingomuso.

insights.item2Text: Ukwakha iinhlelo ze-LLM ezihlanganisiweko ezihlela, ziqinisekise, begodu zenze ukugeleza komsebenzi webhizinisi okuyinkimbinkimbi ngokutjheja kwabantu.
insights.item3Title: Iyaziwa hlangana nama-studio we-IT ahamba phambili e-Hyderabad
insights.item3Text: Isitudiyo sethu sobunjiniyela sivunywe ngokuletha okuhle, amakghono wethekhnoloji ejulileko, nokwaneliseka kwamaklayenti kibo boke ubunjiniyela bemikhiqizo yephasi loke.

digitalTransformation.row4P2: Ubunjiniyela bepulatifomu, i-telemetry, kanye nama-loop wokuphendula azenzekelayo kwenza ukusungulwa kwedijithali kuragele phambili.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Iinsetjenziswa ezitjheje imiphumela eziqinisekisa uburholi obuqinileko bedijithali.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Amapulani wokutjhuguluka ngezigaba ngokwenza imodeli yezamabhizinisi, ukulawulwa kwezakhiwo, nokulandelela ubungozi obuqakathekileko.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: I-AWS/Azure/GCP ama-multi-cloud foundations, amapayipi azenzekelayo, kanye nokuvunyelwa kokuhlaziywa kwedatha yamabhizinisi.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Ukuzenzakalela kwenqubo ehlakaniphileko, ama-ejenti we-AI wokucabanga, kanye ne-telemethri yokubikezela ukwenza ngcono imisebenzi yangelanga.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Ama-portal wedijithali atjhugulula khulu ama-omnichannel kanye nama-interface enziwe ngomuntu mathupha akhiwe ukugcinwa kwabasebenzisi.
digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Ukusebenzisana ne-Oklut Technologies malungana nokutjhuguluka kwedijithali okunganabungozi okuhlobene nemiphumela yebhizinisi elinganisekako.

Amakhukhi aqakathekileko ahlala avunyelwe ngombana iwebhusayithi angeze yasebenza kuhle ngaphandle kwawo. Zigcina iseshini nobujamo bokuqinisekisa begodu zikhumbula ukukhetha kwakho kwe-cookie.

section3.title: 3. Isisekelo somthetho (GDPR)
body: Sisebenza idatha yomuntu mathupha ngezisekelo ezilandelako zomthetho: imvumo yakho (yamakhukhi angakaqakatheki nokuthengisa), ukusebenza kwekontraga (ngeenkonzo ozibawako), isibopho somthetho, kanye neenrhuluphelo ezisemthethweni lapho amalungelo wakho angazidluli khona. section4.title: 4. Amalungelo wakho
body: Ngokuya ngendawo ohlala kiyo, ungaba nelungelo lokufinyelela, ukulungisa, ukusula, nofana ukukhandela ukusetjenziswa kwedatha yakho, ukuphikisa ukusetjenziswa, nokuphatheka kwedatha. Ungafaka isikhalazo esiphathisweni sendawo yakho.

ai-robotics-solutions.tagline: Ithekhnoloji ehlakaniphileko. Imisebenzi ezenzakalelayo. Ibhizinisi elihlakaniphileko.
overview: Ubuhlakani bokufakelwa namarobhothi atjhugulula indlela iinhlangano ezisebenza ngayo, ezenza iinqunto, begodu ziletha inani. Iinsombululo zethu ze-AI namarobhothi zisiza amabhizinisi bona adlule ekuzisebenzeni okujayelekileko ngokuhlanganisa ubuhlakani bokwakha, ukufunda ngomtjhini, umbono wekhomphyutha, ukuzikhakhazisa kwenqubo ehlakaniphileko, kanye namarobhothi ukurarulula iintjhijilo zebhizinisi ezisebenzako.

Siklama iinsombululo ezihlakaniphileko eziphathelene nemiphumela yebhizinisi elinganisekako. Kungakhathaliseki bona isidingo kukuzenzakalela umsebenzi ophindaphindwako, ukuhlaziya imininingwana eminengi, ukuthola amaphetheni, ukusekela iinqunto, nofana ukwethula amarobhothi eendaweni zokusebenza, indlela yethu igxile ekuthembekeni, ukulinganisa, ukuvikeleka, kanye nenani lebhizinisi lesikhathi eside.
transformation: Iinhlangano zesimanjemanje zikhiqiza idatha enengi khulu begodu zenza iinkulungwana zemisebenzi ebuyelelweko qobe langa. I-AI namarobhothi angatjhugulula imisebenzi le ibe yindlela yokusebenza ehlakaniphileko, ezenzakalelayo eyenza ngcono ukukhiqiza ngesikhathi ivumela abasebenzi bona badzimelele emisebenzini ephezulu.

Iinsombululo zethu zingasiza iinhlangano ukuthi zenze imisebenzi ephindaphindiweko, zinciphise ukungenelela ngesandla, zithuthukise ukunemba, zihlaziye ilwazi eliyinkimbinkimbi, zisekele iinqunto ezirhabako, zithuthukise ukusetjenziswa kwemithombo, zithuthukise amava wamakhasimende, begodu zakhe amahlelo ahlakaniphileko angalinganiswa.

capabilities.desc: Sithuthukisa iinsombululo eziqhutshwa yi-AI ezenza bona amasistimu azwisise ilwazi, abone amaphetheni, akhiqize ilwazi, begodu asekele iinqunto zebhizinisi.

capabilities.title: Ukufunda ngomtjhini

capabilities.desc: I-NLP ingasetjenziselwa ukusebenza amadokhumende, ukuzwisisa umtlolo, ukuhlukanisa ilwazi, ukukhipha okuqukethwe okufaneleko, nokusekela iinsetjenziswa zokukhulumisana.

capabilities.desc: I-AI ingahlanganiswa nokuzenzakalela kokugeleza komsebenzi ukwenza amahlelo ahlathulula ilwazi, asebenzise imithetho yamabhizinisi nofana amamodeli, begodu athome ikambiso efaneleko ngokuzenzakalelako.

information-reporting-systems.title: Ilwazi neenHlelo zokubika
information-reporting-systems.tagline: Ilwazi elifaneleko. Ngesikhathi esifaneleko. Ukwenza iinqunto ezingcono.
overview: Abadosiphambili bamabhizinisi namathimu wokusebenza bathembele elwazini eliqondileko ukwenza iinqunto eziphumelelako. Iinhlelo zethu zelwazi nokubika zisiza iinhlangano ukubuthelela, ukuhlela, ukuhlaziya, nokwethula ilwazi lebhizinisi ngokusebenzisa iinhlelo zelwazi ezihlelekileko, amaplatifomu wokubika, amadeshibhodi, kanye nokusebenza kokubika okuzenzakalelayo.

Iinhlangano zivame ukuba nelwazi elisakazwe kizo zoke iinsetjenziswa, amaspredishithi, ama-database, kanye neenhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kwenza kube budisi ukusungula umbono ongatjhugulukiko wokusebenza kwebhizinisi. Sisiza ukuhlanganisa imithombo yelwazi eendaweni zokubika ezihlelekileko ezinikela ilwazi lebhizinisi elithembekileko, elifinyelelekako, nelingatjhugulukiko.
transformation: Irherho lokubika akukafaneli litjengise iinomboro kwaphela. Kufanele kusize abasebenzisi bazwisise ukusebenza, babone imiraro, bathole amathuba, begodu benze iinqunto ezizwakalako.
Siklama iindawo zokubika eziphathelene nendlela ihlangano yakho esebenza ngayo, siletha idatha ehlelekileko ukuya esiquntwini esilungiselelwe woke amazinga wokuphatha.

managed-services.tagline: Imisebenzi Yethekhnoloji Ethembekileko. Isekelo leengcwethi. Ukuthuthuka okuragela phambili.
overview: Iindawo ze-IT zesimanjemanje ziyinkimbinkimbi begodu zihlala zitjhuguluka. Iinhlangano zitlhoga umthangalasiseko othembekileko, iinsetjenziswa, amanethiwekhi, ukuphepha, ukutjheja, kanye nokusekelwa kwezobuchwepheshe ukugcina imisebenzi yamabhizinisi isebenza.

Iinkonzo zethu eziLawulwako zinikela ngokulawulwa kwethekhnoloji okuragela phambili nokusekelwa kokusebenza, okuvumela iinhlangano bona zigcine iindawo ze-IT ezithembekileko ngesikhathi amathimu wangaphakathi adzimelele emizamweni yamaqhinga.
transformation: Ukusekelwa kwe-IT kwendabuko kuvame ukutjheja ukurarulula imiraro ngemva kobana ivele. Iinkonzo ezilawulwako zithatha indlela yokuthoma ngokuragela phambili nokutjheja umthangalasiseko, iinsetjenziswa, amahlelo, kanye neendawo zokusebenza.
Indlela le irhelebha ukukhomba imiraro engaba khona msinyana, ukugcina ukusebenza, ukuthuthukisa ukutholakala, nokwehlisa ukuphazamiseka kokusebenza okugwemekako.

capabilities.title: Ukulawulwa kwesicelo

customDevelopment.description: Ukuthuthukiswa kokuphela kokuphela kweensombululo ezitjha zedijithali ukusuka eemfunekweni zebhizinisi nokwakhiwa kwesisombululo ngokuthuthukisa, ukuhlanganiswa, ukuhlolwa, ukuthunyelwa, nokusekela okuragela phambili.
customDevelopment.row1Title: Ukuthuthukiswa kokuphela ukuya ekupheleni ukusuka eemfunekweni ukuya esikalini
customDevelopment.row1P1: Ihlelo ngalinye elitjha ledijithali lithoma ngeemfuneko ezihlukileko, ukugeleza komsebenzi, kanye nemigomo yamaqhinga engeze yahlangabezwa yisofthiwe efanele woke umuntu. Sikhethekile ekwakheni iinhlelo zesofthiwe ezisebenza kuhle khulu ukusuka ekuthomeni.
customDevelopment.row1P2: Kusukela ekutholweni kweemfuneko zokuthoma kanye nokuklanywa kwesakhiwo sezobuchwepheshe ukuya ekuthuthukisweni kwe-agile sprint, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-API ecosystem, amapayipi wokuhlola aqinileko, nokuthunyelwa kwamafu okuzenzakalelayo, amathimu wethu wobunjiniyela aphezulu athatha ubunikazi obupheleleko bomjikelezo wokuphila komkhiqizo wakho.
customDevelopment.row2P1: Siklama izakhiwo zesofthiwe eziqinileko ezilungiselelwe ukujamelana nemithwalo emikhulu yokukhiqiza. Kusukela kuma-microservices amamojula kanye nama-backend aqhutshwa mcimbi ukuya ekusakazeni kwedatha okuphezulu kanye nama-API we-GraphQL/REST, sakha amapulatifomu alinganisa ngaphandle komzamo.
customDevelopment.row2P2: Ngokusungula amakhodi ahlanzekileko, ahlanganiswe nokuhlolwa okuzenzakalelako nokuthobela ukuphepha okuragela phambili, siqinisekisa bona isisekelo sakho sesofthiwe siyagcinwa, siyahlolwa, begodu silungele ukutjhuguluka kwesikhathi eside.

customDevelopment.row3P2: Ngamademo we-sprint abonakalako, ukubonwa kwesikhathi sangempela, kanye nebelo eliqhutshwa yipumelelo, siqinisekisa isikhathi esirhabako sokuya emakethe ngaphandle kokubeka engozini ukuphepha, ukuzinza, nofana isipiliyoni somsebenzisi.
customDevelopment.row4Title: Imisebenzi ethembekileko ye-24/7 nokuTjhuguluka kwesikhathi eside

customDevelopment.row4P2: Isiqhema sethu sobunjiniyela sisebenza njengesingezelelo semvelo senhlangano yakho, siqinisekisa bona akunasikhathi sokuphumula nokuphakama kwethekhnoloji okuragela phambili emakethe yakho.
customDevelopment.pillarsSub: Phetha amakghono we-stack epheleleko enziwe ukuthatha imibono yakho ukusuka ku-zero ukuya ekukhiqizweni.
customDevelopment.pillar1Desc: Ukuhlaziywa kwebhizinisi okujulileko, ukucaciswa kokusebenza, kanye nokubekwa kwekhambo lomsebenzisi ukuhlathulula imingcele yesisombululo esiqondileko.
customDevelopment.pillar2Desc: Izakhiwo ze-cloud-native ezilinganiselweko, ukumodela idathabheyisi, ukuklanywa kwamasevisi amancani, kanye nezisekelo zezokuphepha ezingathenjwa.
customDevelopment.pillar3Desc: Iinsetjenziswa zesimanjemanje ezipheleleko zewebhu nezeselula ezenziwe ngekhodi ehlanzekileko, ukuphepha komhlobo, kanye namazinga we-UI asebenzako.

customDevelopment.pillar5Desc: Ukuzenzakalela kokuhlola okuqinileko, ukuhlolwa komthwalo/ukugandeleleka, ukuskena kobuthakathaka, kanye nama-suite wokuhlolwa wokubuyela emuva.
customDevelopment.pillar6Desc: Amapayipi we-CI/CD azenzekelayo, ukuhleleka kwekhonteyina (i-Docker/K8s), umthangalasiseko njengekhodi, nokukhishwa kwesikhathi esingekho.
customDevelopment.pillar7Desc: Ukutjheja okusebenzako 24/7, ukuhlolwa kwezamaphilo, ukuhlolwa kokusebenza, ukulungiswa kwezokuphepha, nokugcinwa kwe-SLA okuragela phambili.
customDevelopment.pillar8Desc: Ijubane elivamileko lezinto, ukuhlanganiswa kokuhlaziywa kwedatha, ukuthuthukiswa kwe-AI, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezakhiwo.

processAutomation.description: Ukuzenzakalela kokusebenza kwamabhizinisi, ukuhlanganisa ukusebenza kwamarobhothi (i-RPA), ukucubungula amadokhumenti ahlakaniphileko, iinjini zemithetho yebhizinisi, nokuhlanganiswa kwehlelo.
processAutomation.row1P1: Ukuqeda ukufaka idatha ngesandla ngokuphindaphindiweko, ukubuyisana kwamasistimu ahlukahlukeneko, nokuthunyelwa kwamadokhumenti. Sithumela amabhothi we-RPA wamabhizinisi enza imisebenzi ehlelekileko 24/7 ngaphandle kwezinga lephutha.
processAutomation.row1P2: Ngokuhlanganisa ama-interface wedeskithophu, ama-backend we-SAP/ERP, kanye nama-database we-cloud, amabhothi wesofthiwe akhulula isiqhema sakho bona sidzimelele emahlelweni wamabhizinisi.

processAutomation.row3Title:
Ukuvumelanisa kwamapulatifomu woke ukusuka ekupheleni ukuya ekupheleni
Xhumanisa i-CRM, i-ERP, i-HRMS, kanye nama-API webhanga abe ziindlela ezihlangeneko zedatha yesikhathi sangempela. Sisebenzisa ama-trigger aqhutshwa mcimbi, imigqa yemilayezo, kanye nabaphathi be-fallback abazenzakalelayo.
processAutomation.row3P1: Hlanganisa i-CRM, i-ERP, i-HRMS, kanye nama-API webhanga abe ziindlela ezihlangeneko zedatha yesikhathi sangempela. Sisebenzisa ama-trigger aqhutshwa mcimbi, imigqa yemilayezo, kanye nabaphathi be-fallback abazenzakalelayo.
processAutomation.row3P2: Ilwazi ligeleza kuhle eminyangweni ngaphandle kokungenelela kwabantu, okuqeda ama-silo wokusebenza nokulibaziseka kokukhulumisana.
processAutomation.row4P1: Landelela iinkhathi zokusebenza kwenqubo, amamephu womtjhiso, amaphutha, kanye ne-ROI yezezimali kumadeshibhodi wesikhathi sangempela.
processAutomation.row4P2: Ukuhlolwa komtjhini okuragela phambili kuthola amathuba amatjha wokuzenzakalela, okwenza bona ibhizinisi lakho lisebenze kuhle khulu.
processAutomation.pillarsSub: Iinsetjenziswa zokwakha ezifakazelweko zokusebenza kwamabhizinisi ahlakaniphileko.
processAutomation.pillar1Desc: Ukusebenza okunamagadango amanengi womuntu ngaphakathi kwe-loop kanye nokusebenza kwedijithali okuhlelwe ngendlela ezenzakalelayo nokukhuphuka.
processAutomation.pillar2Desc: Amabhothi wesofthiwe asekelwe emithethweni enza imisebenzi yokufaka idatha, ukubuyisana, nemisebenzi yokusebenzisana.
processAutomation.pillar3Desc: Ama-ejenti we-AI wokucabanga ahlathulula ubujamo, afingqa umtlolo ongakahleleki, begodu enza iinqunto ezizenzakalelayo.
processAutomation.pillar4Desc: Ukumayina kwenqubo, ukuthola iinqabo, kanye nokugeleza komsebenzi we-Kaizen okuragela phambili nokwehlisa iindleko zokusebenza.
processAutomation.ctaSub: Xhumana nabakhi bethu be-automation ukukhomba amathuba we-ROI ephezulu begodu uthumele ukugeleza komsebenzi okuhlakaniphileko kwedijithali.

centreOfExcellence.description: Ihlangano ehlangeneko yabakhi abaphezulu kanye neengcwethi ezizinikele ekulinganiseni imikhuba yobunjiniyela, ukuqhuba ukusungulwa kwezinto ezitjha, nokurhabisa amagadango wedijithali.
centreOfExcellence.exploreStandards:
Hlola amazinga wobunjiniyela
Qalisa ukuhlolwa kwe-CoE
centreOfExcellence.row1P1: Isikhungo sethu sokuPhatha kuhle sisungula amaphetheni wokuklama ajwayelekileko, ukuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo okuqinileko, kanye nemikhuba yokubuyekeza ikhodi engenawo amaphutha ekhawuleza isikhathi sokuya emakethe ngesikhathi kugcinwa isikwelede sezobuchwepheshe sibe yi-zero.
centreOfExcellence.row1F1: Amapayipi wokukhipha we-CI/CD azenzekelayo nge-DORA metrics analytics
centreOfExcellence.row1F2: Amabhodi wokubuyekezwa kwezakhiwo eziqinileko nokulawulwa kwamasevisi amancani
centreOfExcellence.row1F3: Ukuragela phambili nokuvikeleka nokulungiswa kobuthakathaka okuzenzakalelayo
centreOfExcellence.row2P1: Silinga amamodeli wokufunda ngomtjhini wezinga eliphezulu, ama-ejenti we-AI, kanye nokuzenzakalela kokusebenza okuhlakaniphileko ukwakha imikhiqizo yamabhizinisi yesizukulwana esilandelako.
centreOfExcellence.row2F2: Ukusebenza kwe-ejenti ye-AI ezimeleko yokuzenzakalela kwenqubo yebhizinisi
centreOfExcellence.row2F3: Ukulungiswa kwemodeli yokufunda ngomtjhini ngokwezifiso nokulungiswa okuhle
centreOfExcellence.row3P1: Siklama begodu silawula iindawo eziqinileko ezinamafu amanengi ezakhiwe phezu kweenhlaka zezokuphepha ezingathembekiko, ukuqinisekisa bona idatha yakho ihlala ivikelekile eensongweni ze-inthanethi ezitjhugulukako.
centreOfExcellence.row3F1: I-AWS, i-Azure, & i-GCP ukuhleleka kwesakhiwo samafu amanengi
centreOfExcellence.row3F2: Ukufinyelela kwenethiwekhi okungathembekiko (i-ZTNA) kanye nemigomo ye-IAM esekelwe endimeni
centreOfExcellence.row3F3: Ukuskena okuzenzakalelayo kwezokuphepha kwekhonteyina nokulawulwa kwemfihlo
centreOfExcellence.pillarsSub: Amabhuku wokudlala wokuthuthukisa ahlelekileko anikela amandla amapulatifomu aqakathekileko.
centreOfExcellence.pillar1Desc: Ukutjheja okupheleleko okuqinisekisa bona zoke iinsombululo zamabhizinisi zihambisana nokulinganisa okuqinileko, ukuphepha, kanye namaphrothokholi wokuthobela.
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Title: Ii-Accelerator ezisetjenziswa godu kanye nelayibhrari yamalunga
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Desc: Iinhlelo zokuklama ezikhethekileko, amakhithi wokuthoma we-API, kanye namathempulethi we-microservice yangemuva okwehlisa isikhathi sokuthuthukisa sokuthoma ngama-40%.
centreOfExcellence.pillar3Desc: Amapayipi wokuqala wesikhathi sangempela athuthukisiweko aqapha ukulibaziseka kwesicelo, iinqabo zokukhiqiza, nokusetjenziswa kwemithombo yamafu.
centreOfExcellence.pillar4Desc: Iinhlangano zangaphakathi ezihlelekileko kanye nezitifiketi ezikhulisa amakghono atjhingako wezobuchwepheshe kiwo woke amafu, i-DevOps, kanye ne-AI esetjenzisiweko.
centreOfExcellence.ctaSub:
Bambisana ne-Oklut Tech's Centre of Excellence ukwakha ama-cloud architectures aqinileko, ukwenza umsebenzi ube ngokuzenzakalelako, nokurhabisa ukulethwa kwemikhiqizo yedijithali.
Hlela ukubonisana kwabaphathi
centreOfExcellence.p1Desc: Sungula ukulawulwa kwezakhiwo zebhizinisi loke, iinqabo zomthethokambiso, kanye namazinga wokuthobela.
centreOfExcellence.p2Desc: Hlathulula izakhiwo zesimanjemanje, iintambo zethekhnoloji ezihloliweko, kanye namaphetheni wamasevisi amancani.
centreOfExcellence.p3Desc: Khuphula ijubane lokuthuthukisa ngeengcenye ezabelwana ngazo, amathempulethi, amakhithi wokuthoma, kanye neenhlelo zokuklama.
centreOfExcellence.p4Desc: Ukubandulwa okuhlelekileko, ukufundiswa kwethekhnoloji, nokukghoniswa kwamakghono ukuphakamisa ikghono lobunjiniyela besiqhema.
centreOfExcellence.p5Desc: I-R&D kuma-ejenti we-AI, amapayipi wokuzenzakalela, kanye namafreyimu wesizukulwana esilandelako ukugcina umkhawulo wemakethe.
centreOfExcellence.p6Desc: Iinlinganiso zobunjiniyela eziqhutshwa yidatha (i-DORA), ukulinganisa kwe-SLA, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi okuqhubekayo.

solutionEngineering.description: Ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukiswa kweensetjenziswa, amaplatifomu, ukugeleza komsebenzi, kanye nezisombululo zamabhizinisi ukutjheja iimfuneko zebhizinisi ezihlukileko nokuletha ukusebenza okwenziwe ngokwezifiso.
solutionEngineering.row1Title: Iimfanelo ezenziwe ngokwezifiso ezakhelwe ukusebenza kwakho
solutionEngineering.row1P1: Isofthiwe yamabhizinisi ejwayelekileko kanengi ayikwazi ukuhlangabezana neendingo zebhizinisi ezikhethekileko. Isiqhema sethu sobunjiniyela esikhethekileko sithuthukisa amamojula weensetjenziswa, imithetho yebhizinisi eyenziwe ngokwezifiso, kanye neenngezelelo ezikhethekileko ezilungiselelwe imisebenzi yakho.
solutionEngineering.row1P2: Ukusuka ekuthuthukisweni kwe-CRM ne-ERP ukuya emaphothalini akhethekileko wokusebenza, sakha iimfanelo ezikhambisana kuhle namaphetheni wokusebenza wesiqhema sakho.
solutionEngineering.row2P1: Hlanganisa amahlelo wesofthiwe ahlukileko abe yi-ecosystem ehlangeneko yedijithali. Senza ama-API we-REST ne-GraphQL, abalawuli be-webhook, kanye nemilayezo yemilayezo yamabhizinisi ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelanisa kwedatha ngesikhathi sangempela kiwo woke amapulatifomu wakho.
solutionEngineering.row2P2: Kungakhathaliseki bona kuhlanganisa amathulusi we-SaaS weqembu lesithathu nofana ukunweba amapulatifomu wangaphakathi, izakhiwo zethu zokuhlanganisa ziqakathekisa ukuthembeka kwedatha, ukusebenza, nokungabi nesikhathi sokuphumula.
solutionEngineering.row3P1: Phakamisa iinsetjenziswa zakade ezineendlela zesimanjemanje, eziphendulako eziklanyelwe ukurhaba nokukhanyisa. Sivuselela ama-frontend ngamaphetheni wokuklama azwakalako, ukuthobela ukufinyeleleka, kanye namamodeli wokuthintana ahlelekileko.
solutionEngineering.row3P2: Ngokufanako, abonjiniyela bethu bokusebenza benza ngcono imibuzo yedathabheyisi, amaqhinga wokugcina, kanye nobukhulu be-frontend ukuletha isikhathi sokuphendula msinyana kiwo woke amadivayisi.
solutionEngineering.pillarsSub: Iindlela zokwenza izinto ngokwezifiso zezinga lamabhizinisi ezakhiwe ukulinganisa ngaphandle komthungo.
solutionEngineering.pillar1Title: Ukugeleza komsebenzi okwenziwe ngokwezifiso kanye nama-extensions
solutionEngineering.pillar1Desc: I-logic yesicelo eyenziwe ngokwezifiso kanye nemitjhini yombuso ezenzakalelayo ehlelwe ngqo ngokuya ngemithetho yakho yangaphakathi yokusebenza.
solutionEngineering.pillar2Desc: Amabhuloho wedatha avikelekileko, aqinisekisiweko ahlanganisa ama-backend womnikazi, ama-ERP suites, amasango wokubhadela, kanye namasevisi we-cloud.
solutionEngineering.pillar3Desc: Ukutjhuguluka okujulileko kwezakhiwo okutjhugulula isofthiwe yamabhizinisi ngaphandle kokuphula iindlela zokuthuthukisa nofana iimvumelwano zokusekela abathengisi.
solutionEngineering.pillar4Desc: Ukwenza iphrofayili yemibuzo eqinileko, ukuqeda ukuvuza kwememori, nokusabalalisa i-CDN ye-edge yokulayisha amakhasi angaphasi kwesibili.
solutionEngineering.ctaSub: Xhumana nabakhi bethu bezisombululo ukuklama nokuthumela amamojula wesintu, ukugeleza komsebenzi, nokuhlanganiswa okulungiselelwe iindingo zebhizinisi lakho.

digitalTransformation.description: Ukuthuthukiswa okupheleleko kweenkambo zamabhizinisi, izakhiwo zethekhnoloji, kanye namamodeli wokusebenza ukuqhuba ukushesha kwenhlangano, ukusebenza kuhle, nokukhula kwedijithali okusimemeko.
digitalTransformation.row1P1: Sisebenzisana nabadosiphambili bamabhizinisi ukuhlathulula iqhinga ledijithali, amacala webhizinisi, kanye namabalazwe wendlela ahlelekileko ngokunqoba okurhabako nokubulawa okungenabungozi.
digitalTransformation.row1P2: Iinhlelo ezibekwe phambili, amamodeli we-TCO, nama-KPI aqinisekisa bona woke umzamo wokuthuthukisa ithekhnoloji uhlobana ngqo nemiphumela yemali engenako, ukusebenza kuhle, nokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende.
digitalTransformation.row2Title: Yenza izinto zesimanjemanje ngaphandle kokuphula ibhizinisi
digitalTransformation.row2P1: Buyisela ama-monoliths weplatifomu abe ma-microservices, ama-API, kanye namaphetheni we-cloud-native nge-zero-downtime cutovers kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokubuyela emuva okuzenzakalelayo.
digitalTransformation.row2P2: Sithuthukisa iinsetjenziswa, ama-database, kanye namalayini wokuhlanganisa ngesikhathi silondoloza ukuthobela nokuvikeleka.
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Yamukela i-AWS, i-Azure, ne-GCP, yakha amapayipi wedatha wesimanjemanje, begodu ufake ama-ejenti wokufunda ngomtjhini ukwenza iinqunto ezizijameleko.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Ukusuka ekusakazeni umcimbi wesikhathi sangempela ukuya kumadeshibhodi ahlangeneko, ukutjhuguluka kuba yinto elinganisekako nehlalako.
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Yakha kabutjha amakhambo wamakhasimende ngaphakathi kwewebhu ephendulako, i-iOS, i-Android, kanye nama-portal wokuzisebenzela ngeensetjenziswa ezikhethekileko.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Ubunjiniyela beplatifomu, i-telemetry, kanye nama-loop wokuphendula azenzekelayo kwenza ukusungulwa kwedijithali kuragele phambili.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Iinsetjenziswa ezitjheje imiphumela eziqinisekisa uburholi obuqinileko bedijithali.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Amapulani wokutjhuguluka ngezigaba ngokwenza imodeli yezamabhizinisi, ukulawulwa kwezakhiwo, nokulandelela ubungozi obuqakathekileko.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: I-AWS/Azure/GCP ama-multi-cloud foundations, amapayipi azenzakalelayo, kanye nokuvunyelwa kokuhlaziywa kwedatha yamabhizinisi.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Ukuzenzakalela kwenqubo ehlakaniphileko, ama-ejenti we-AI wokucabanga, kanye ne-telemethri yokubikezela ukwenza ngcono imisebenzi yangelanga.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Ama-portal wedijithali we-omnichannel atjhugulula khulu kanye nama-interface enziwe ngomuntu mathupha akhiwe ukugcinwa kwabasebenzisi.
digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Ukusebenzisana ne-Oklut Technologies malungana nokutjhuguluka kwedijithali okungekho engozini okuhlobene nemiphumela yebhizinisi elinganisekako.

endToEndSolutions.description: Ihlelo elihlelekileko, elipheleleko lokuletha elihlanganisa iimfuneko zebhizinisi, ukuklanywa kwezakhiwo, ubunjiniyela, ukuhlanganiswa, ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, ukuthunyelwa kwamafu, nemisebenzi elawulwako.
endToEndSolutions.row1P1: Ama-workshops wokubambisana, ukubekwa kwemephu yesizinda sebhizinisi, kanye nokucaciswa kokwakhiwa kwefu okwenzelwe ukuqeda ubungozi ngaphambi kokuthi kutlolwe umugqa wekhodi.
endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Sihlathulula amamodeli wedatha, iinhlaka zezokuphepha, kanye namagadango wokulinganisa abeka ipumelelo yesikhathi eside.
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Amasevisi amancani wamamojula, ama-API aphephileko, kanye nama-frontend aphendulako ahlanganiswe neyunithi ezenzakalelayo, ukuhlanganiswa, kanye nokuskena kwezokuphepha.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Amapayipi wokuhlanganisa aragela phambili nge-GitHub Actions, i-Terraform, kanye nama-automated security guardrails.
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: Ukuhlelwa kwamafu amanengi ku-AWS/Azure/GCP ngokubuyela emuva okuzenzakalelayo, ukusika isikhathi sokuphumula, nokubonwa kwesikhathi sangempela.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Sinikela ngokugcinwa okusekelwe yi-SLA nokutjheja okuragela phambili kwe-telemetry ukuthuthukisa umkhiqizo wakho ngaphandle komraro.
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Ukuziphendulela kwephuzu elilodwa kiyo yoke i-stack yakho yedijithali — ijubane lokugijima elikhanyako, ukubekelwa kwemali okubikezelwako, nokusungula okuragela phambili.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Ukukhiqizwa kweempawu njalo kanye nemijikelezo yokwenza izinto zibe zesimanjemanje kwenza ibhizinisi lakho libe phambili kunomncintiswano.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Ukutholwa kwesizinda, amabalazwe wendlela yokwakha, nokulungiswa kwabathintekako ukuqeda ubungozi bokwenza.
endToEndSolutions.pillar2Desc: Amasevisi amancani we-cloud-native aqinileko, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-API, nokuhlolwa kwe-QA okuragela phambili.
endToEndSolutions.pillar3Desc: Ukuthobela ukuvikeleka okunganathemba, ukukhutjhwa okufakwe esitjeni, nokuthunyelwa kwamafu okuzenzakalelayo.
endToEndSolutions.pillar4Desc: Ukutjheja i-SLA 24/7, i-telemetry yezamaphilo, kanye nobunjiniyela bokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuragela phambili.
endToEndSolutions.ctaSub: Siphethe umjikelezo wethekhnoloji opheleleko ukwenzela bona isiqhema sakho sikghone ukutjheja imiphumela yebhizinisi eqakathekileko.

migrationServices.description: Ukufuduka okuphephileko, okuhlelekileko kweensetjenziswa zakade, ama-database, kanye nomthangalasiseko ukuya ezakhiweni zamafu zesimanjemanje, okuhlanganiswe nokuthuthukiswa okuragela phambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukushesha nokusebenza kuhle.
migrationServices.row1P1: Ukufuduka komthwalo womsebenzi ngaphandle komthungo ku-AWS, Azure, kanye ne-Google Cloud ngokutholakala okuzenzakalelayo, ukuhlela amagagasi, nokungaphazamiseki kwebhizinisi.
migrationServices.row1P2: Silinganisa ukusingatha kabutjha, ukubuyisela ipulatifomu, nokubuyisela kabutjha ukwenza ngcono iindleko zobunikazi (TCO) nokurhaba.
migrationServices.row2P1: Ukuphindaphindwa kwedathabheyisi okuzenzakalelayo, ukuhumusha kwe-schema, kanye namapayipi we-ETL aphezulu ngokuqinisekiswa kobuqotho bedatha obuyi-100%.
migrationServices.row2P2: Ukuzijayeza kwesikhathi sokuphumula esingekho kuqinisekisa ukunzinza kwedatha okupheleleko nokuragela phambili kwebhizinisi.
migrationServices.row3P1: Yenza ama-monolith wesimanjemanje abe ma-microservices alinganisekako ahlelwe nge-Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) ngamapulani we-IaC azenzekelayo.
migrationServices.row3P2: Ukuphrofayila kokusebenza ngemva kokufuduka nokwenza ngcono iindleko kuqinisekisa i-ROI esheshako.
migrationServices.row4Title: Ukuhlolwa okuzenzakalelako nokubuyisela emuva amanethi wokuphepha
migrationServices.row4P1: Ama-runbook we-cutover ahlolwe epini, ama-suite wokubuyela emuva ngokuzenzakalelako, kanye neendlela zokubuyela emuva msinyana zokuthula okupheleleko kwengqondo.
migrationServices.row4P2: I-telemetry yezamaphilo yangemuva kokufuduka kanye nokutlhogonyelwa okukhulu kwama-24/7 kuqinisekisa ukuzinza kokukhiqiza okungenaphutha.
migrationServices.pillarsSub: Ukunyakaza okungekho engozini okusekelwe ma-SLA wamabhizinisi.
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: I-Canary ikhupha nokuvumelanisa kokutlola okubili kwedathabheyisi ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela komsebenzisi okungaphazanyiswako.
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Ukumadanisa i-checksum, ukuhlolwa kobuqotho be-schema, nokubuyisana kwe-ETL okuzenzakalelayo.
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Amaphrothokholi aqinileko wokuvuselela ngemva kweenhlekelele kanye nokuzijayeza ukuvala ubungozi kizo zoke iingaba.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Ukulinganisa amafu, imigomo yokulinganisa ngokuzenzakalelako, kanye namadeshibhodi wokulawula iindleko afakiwe.
migrationServices.ctaSub: Bambisana ne-Oklut Technologies malungana nokuthuthukisa amafu nedatha ehlelekileko, enganabungozi.

pilotPrototyping.description: Ukuthuthukiswa okurhabako nokuqinisekiswa kweensombululo zethekhnoloji ukuhlola ukusebenza kwethekhnoloji, inani lebhizinisi, iimfuneko zokuhlanganiswa, ukusebenza, nokulinganisa ngaphambi kokusetjenziswa ngokuzeleko.
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Ukutjhugulula umbono ube sisombululo sebhizinisi kutlhoga ukuqinisekiswa okuqinileko ngaphambilini. Isevisi yethu ye-PoC & Pilot ihlola ukusebenza kwethekhnoloji, ihlola ukugandeleleka kwama-hook wokuhlanganisa aqakathekileko, begodu iqinisekisa i-ROI yebhizinisi ngaphambi kokuzibophelela okukhulu kwemali.
pilotPrototyping.row1P2: Sakha ama-MVP athembeka khulu kanye nama-sandbox pilots agxile afakazela ukusebenza kwezobuchwepheshe, alinganise ukulibaziseka kwehlelo, begodu abuthelele ukuqinisekiswa kwabathintekako kusesenesikhathi.
pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: Ukutholwa kwe-MVP okurhabako kanye nama-benchmark wezobuchwepheshe
pilotPrototyping.row2P1: Sakha ama-wirefreyimu asebenzisanako, ukugeleza kwabasebenzisi okuchofozako, kanye nobufakazi obusebenzako bemiqondo emalangeni, ingasi iinyanga. Hlola ukusebenzisana kwabasebenzisi bamambala, lungiselela amaphetheni we-UI/UX, begodu uqoqe iimpendulo ezisebenzako ezivela ebantwini abathintekako.
pilotPrototyping.row2P2: Ngokunciphisa ama-loop wokuphendula ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwangaphambilini, isiqhema sakho sinciphisa ukusebenza kabutjha begodu sisungula iinqophiso ezicacileko zobuchwepheshe ngaphambi kokuthi iingaba zokwakha ezitlhoga imali enengi zithome.
pilotPrototyping.row3P1: Vula iinqabo zezobuchwepheshe, imikhawulo ye-API, kanye nemikhawulo yokusebenza ngaphambi kokuzibophezela okupheleleko kwemali. Isiqhema sethu sobunjiniyela sokulinga sihlola ukuhlanganiswa, amapayipi wedatha, kanye nama-API wabantu besithathu eendaweni ezihlukileko.
pilotPrototyping.row3P2: Ukunciphisa ubungozi okusebenzako kuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwehlelo eliphezulu, ukuthobela ukuphepha, kanye nesikhathi sokuthuthukisa esiqagelekako lokha nawutjhugulula i-PoC yakho ibe yikukhiqizwa kwebhizinisi.
pilotPrototyping.row4Title: Ukuhlonywa kwePilothi okuTjhejiweko nokuqinisekiswa kwecala lebhizinisi
pilotPrototyping.row4P1: Thumela ukukhishwa kokuhlola okuqothelweko esigabeni somsebenzisi esikhethiweko nofana imakethe yokuhlola. Landelela amamethrikhi wokusebenza, ukuhlaziywa kokwamukelwa kwabasebenzisi, kanye nempendulo yokusebenza ukulinganisa inani lebhizinisi nokusungula icala lebhizinisi elisekelwe yidatha.
pilotPrototyping.row4P2: Ngokuzwisisa kwephasi lamambala, abaxhasi abaphezulu bathola amamethrikhi acacileko we-ROI ukuthethelela ukuthunyelwa okubanzi nokutjala imali ngokutjhugulula idijithali.
pilotPrototyping.pillarsSub: Imigomo eqondisako eguqula ukungaqiniseki kwezobuchwepheshe kube yimpumelelo yebhizinisi eqagelekako.
pilotPrototyping.pillar1Desc: Khipha amaphrothothayipi asebenzako msinyana ukuqinisekisa iimphakamiso zenani ekuthomeni komjikelezo wokuphila.
pilotPrototyping.pillar2Desc: Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwe-API, imikhawulo yokukhiqiza, kanye nemikhawulo yokuthobela eendaweni ze-sandbox.
pilotPrototyping.pillar3Desc: Lingisa umthwalo wokukhiqiza ukusungula imikhawulo yamandla begodu unqume ubukhulu bokwakhiwa kwamafu.
pilotPrototyping.pillar4Desc: Qala i-ROI ephathekako kanye namamethrikhi wokukhiqiza ukusekela iinqunto zokurhatjhwa kwebhizinisi loke.
pilotPrototyping.ctaTitle: Ukulungele ukuqinisekisa isisombululo sakho esilandelako sedijithali?
pilotPrototyping.ctaSub: Xhumana nethimba lethu lobunjiniyela beensombululo ukuhlola iimfuneko zephrojekthi yakho, ukwakha umfanekiso, nokuhlola ukusebenza ngaphandle kobungozi.

sharedServices.description: Ukulethwa okuhlangeneko kwethekhnoloji namakghono wokusebenza kiwo woke amayunithi webhizinisi ngokusebenzisa iinkambo ezijayelekileko, iinsetjenziswa ezinamakghono, iinhlaka zokulawula, ukuphathwa kweenkonzo, kanye namazinga weenkonzo alinganisekako.
sharedServices.row1Title: Iinsetjenziswa ezijayelekileko kiwo woke amayunithi webhizinisi
sharedServices.row1P1: Hlanganisa i-IT ye-ofisi yangemuva, ukulawulwa kwesakhiwo, kanye nokusekelwa kwezobuchwepheshe kube yindawo eyodwa yokuletha esebenza kuhle khulu.
sharedServices.row1P2: Ngokuqeda ukuphindaphindwa kweqembu eliphezulu nokulinganisa amamodeli wokulethwa kweenkonzo, ihlangano yakho ivikela ikhwalithi engaguqukiko begodu yehlisa iindleko zokusebenza.
sharedServices.row2P1: I-Site Reliability Engineers (SRE) yethu ezizinikeleko kanye neengcwethi ezisekelako zinikela ngokutjheja kwe-telemetry 24/7/365, ukuhlunga okuzenzakalelayo, nokurarulula okurhabako kwemiraro ye-L1/L2/L3.
sharedServices.row2P2: Ngokusekelwa ziimbopho eziqinileko ze-SLA, siqinisekisa ukutholakala kwe-99.99% yeensetjenziswa zakho eziqakathekileko zomsebenzi kanye nesakhiwo samafu.
sharedServices.row3P1: Sebenzisa amazinga we-ITSM adosa phambili embonini (i-ServiceNow, i-Jira Service Management) ngokuthengisa okusobala, ukuhlaziywa kwembangela, kanye nama-guardrail wokulawula amatjhuguluko.
sharedServices.row3P2: Iindlela zokuhlola ezipheleleko kanye nemigomo yokuphatha iqinisekisa bona imisebenzi yakho ihlala ihambisana namazinga wezokuphepha weentjhabatjhaba.
sharedServices.row4P1: Ukuqeda ukulahlwa kwamafu, ngcono ukulinganisa kwekhompyutha, begodu wenze ngokuzenzakalelako ukugcinwa kokusebenza okujayelekileko ngeendlela ezihle khulu ze-FinOps.
sharedServices.row4P2: Imibiko yenyanga yokukhanya nokubikezela kwamandla kuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kweendleko zokusebenza okuragela phambili nokusebenza kuhle kwemali.
sharedServices.pillarsSub: Iinsetjenziswa ezisebenzako eziqinisekisiweko zokukhula kwebhizinisi okuthembekileko.
sharedServices.pillar1Desc: I-NOC telemetry esebenzako, ukulungiswa kweseva, ukugcinwa kwesakhiwo, kanye neziqinisekiso zesikhathi sokusebenza ezingu-99.99%.
sharedServices.pillar2Desc: I-Tier 1/2/3 multi-channel helpdesk, ukuthunyelwa kwesehlakalo, kanye nokusebenza okuhlelekileko kokurarulula amathikithi.
sharedServices.pillar3Desc: Isikhathi sokuphendula esisekelwa sivumelwano, amazinga we-MTTR, kanye nokuhlolwa kokusebenza kwanyanga zonke okusobala.
sharedServices.pillar4Desc: Ukulinganisa okuragela phambili kwemithombo, ukubuyiselwa kwelayisense, kanye nokwehliswa kweendleko zamafu ezizenzakalelayo.
sharedServices.ctaSub: Bambisana ne-Oklut Technologies malungana namasevisi athembekileko, alawulwako 24/7 enza ngcono iindleko begodu aqede isikhathi sokuphumula.

aiRobotics.intro: Ubuhlakani bokufakelwa (i-AI) kanye namarobhothi atjhugulula indlela amabhizinisi asebenza ngayo ngokuhlanganisa ukuthatha iinqunto okuhlakaniphileko nokuzenzakalela okuthuthukileko. I-AI yenza bona imitjhini ihlaziye idatha, ifunde amaphetheni, begodu yenze iinqunto ezihlakaniphileko, ngesikhathi amarobhothi aletha amakghono la ephasini elibonakalako ukwenza imisebenzi ngebelo, ngokunemba, nangokungatjhuguluki.
aiRobotics.section1Text: Iinsombululo zethu ze-AI namarobhothi zisiza iinhlangano ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi, ukwehlisa umzamo wezandla, nokwenza ngcono umkhiqizo emabubulweni ahlukahlukeneko. Kusukela ekuzenzekelayo kwenqubo nokuhlaziywa okubikezelako ukuya emarobhothini ahlakaniphileko kanye neenhlelo ezihlakaniphileko, siletha amathekhnoloji amatjha akhuphula ukusebenza kuhle, akhuthaze ukukhula, begodu asekele ukutjhuguluka kwedijithali.
aiRobotics.section2Text: Ukusebenzisana, isiqunto, nokunyakaza kunikelwa amandla lihlelo elilodwa elihlangeneko — eliguqula idatha ibe yimiphumela ngesikhathi sangempela.

informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Umthombo munye weqiniso kiyo yoke iminyango — eyakhelwe ukutjhugulula idatha yokusebenza engakalungiswa ibe ziinqunto ibhizinisi lakho elingathatha amagadango kizo namhlanjesi.
informationReporting.section1Heading: Irherho elilodwa elihlanganisiweko kiwo woke amamethrikhi aqakathekileko
informationReporting.section1P1: IinHlelo zeLwazi nokuBika ziinsombululo eziqakathekileko zebhizinisi ezenza iinhlangano zikwazi ukubuthelela, ukulawula, nokutjhugulula idatha ibe yilwazi elizwakalako. Iinhlelo lezi zihlanganisa ilwazi elivela eminyangweni eminengi, ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela okunembileko, okungaguqukiko, nokufikelela ngesikhathi sangempela kudatha yebhizinisi eqakathekileko. Ngokunikela ngeplatifomu ehlanganisiweko yokulawulwa kwelwazi, iinhlangano zingenza ngcono ukubonakala kokusebenza, zithuthukise ukugeleza komsebenzi, begodu zisekele ukuthatha iinqunto eziqakathekileko kiwo woke amazinga webhizinisi.
informationReporting.section1P2: Amasistimu la asebenzisa ukubika okuzenzakalelayo, ukuhlaziya, namadeshibhodi ukulandelela ukusebenza, ukutjheja amamethrikhi aqakathekileko, nokukhiqiza imibiko yesikhathi sangempela. Ngokwehlisa umzamo wezandla nokwenza ngcono ukunemba kwedatha, amabhizinisi angenza iinqunto ezirhabako neziphumelelako.
informationReporting.section2Text: Ngokubonakala okuthuthukisiweko, ukuthobela, nokusebenzisana, iNqubo yeLwazi nokuBika yenza iinhlangano zikwazi ukuthuthukisa iinkambo, zithuthukise umkhiqizo, begodu ziqhube ukukhula kwebhizinisi okusimemeko endaweni enomncintiswano.
informationReporting.ctaHeading: Nikela woke amathimu isithombe esifanako sebhizinisi.
informationReporting.ctaText: Bona bona i-Nexus Data Systems ingahlanganisa njani ukubika kwakho kube yipulatifomu eyodwa ehlakaniphileko.

business-transformation.title: Ukuthuthukisa iinsetjenziswa zebhizinisi zebhizinisi eliqhutshwa yidatha
business-transformation.excerpt: Indlela ukwakhiwa kwesicelo sesimanjemanje nedatha exhumeneko engathuthukisa ngayo ukusebenza kuhle, ukulinganisa nokubonakala kwebhizinisi.
business-transformation.summary: Isicelo sesimanjemanje nesisekelo sedatha kungasiza amabhizinisi ukwenza ngcono ukusebenza kuhle, ukuhlanganisa amahlelo webhizinisi nokwenza ukubonakala okungcono kiyo yoke imisebenzi yawo.

artificial-intelligence.title: Indlela i-AI ebumba kabutjha ngayo iinsetjenziswa zamabhizinisi
artificial-intelligence.excerpt: Hlola bona ukuzijamela okuhlakaniphileko, ama-AI copilot kanye nokuhlakanipha okubikezelako kuba yingcenye yeensetjenziswa zamabhizinisi amabhizinisi athembele kizo qobe langa.
artificial-intelligence.summary: Hlola bona ukuzenzakalela okuhlakaniphileko, ama-AI copilot kanye nokuhlakanipha okubikezelako kutjhugulula njani isofthiwe yamabhizinisi wangamalanga ibe ziinkundla ezitjhugulukako, ezisebenzako.

modern-erp.title: Ukurhabisa ukutjhuguluka kwamabhizinisi nge-ERP yesimanjemanje
modern-erp.excerpt: Hlola bona amapulatifomu we-ERP wesimanjemanje ahlanganisa njani ezezimali, ukuthenga, ukusabalalisa kanye nemisebenzi yamabhizinisi ngesisekelo sedijithali esihlangeneko.
modern-erp.summary: Iplatifomu yesimanjemanje ye-ERP ihlanganisa ezezimali, ukuthenga, ukusabalalisa, kanye nemisebenzi yamabhizinisi ibe yimodeli yokusebenza ehlangeneko, yesikhathi sangempela.

cybersecurity.title: Ukwakha ukuqina kwe-inthanethi ebhizinisini elihlangeneko
cybersecurity.excerpt: Hlola bona iinhlangano zingaqinisa njani ukuphepha, zivikele amahlelo aqakathekileko begodu zilungiselele iinsongo kizo zoke iindawo ezihlangeneko.
cybersecurity.summary: Njengombana amabhizinisi ahlanganisa amahlelo amanengi wamafu, ama-API, kanye nama-ecosystem wabalingani, ukuqina kwe-inthanethi kuqinisekisa bona imisebenzi eqakathekileko imelana neentjhijilo zesimanjemanje.

cloud-modernization.title: Ukuthuthukisa iinsetjenziswa ezidala zefu
cloud-modernization.excerpt: Hlola indlela esebenzako yokuhlola, ukwenza ibe yesimanjemanje nokuthuthela iinsetjenziswa zakade ukuya ezakhiweni zamafu ezivikelekileko.
cloud-modernization.summary: Indlela ehlelekileko, esebenzako yokuhlola, ukuvuselela, nokufudukela amahlelo wamabhizinisi aqinileko ukuya ekwakhiweni kwamafu okuguquguqukako, okugcinwako.

businessTransformation.sec1Subtext: Njengoba amabhizinisi akhula, iinkambiso zethekhnoloji ziyakhula. Lokho okuthoma njengeensombululo ezitjhejileko zeminyango ngayinye kungatjhuguluka kube yiwebhu ephitheneko yamahlelo ahlukileko.
businessTransformation.sec2Subtext: Lokha iinsetjenziswa zebhizinisi, ama-database, kanye neenhlelo zokusebenza zitjhuguluka ngokuzijamela, ukugeleza kwelwazi kuyahlukana. Ukuzwisisa ukuhlukana lokhu kuligadango lokuthoma eliqakathekileko.
businessTransformation.sec3Subtext: Amabhizinisi atjhidela ekwakhiweni okuqhutshwa mcimbi, i-API yokuthoma lapho idatha igeleza ngokuthembeka emaplatifomu aqakathekileko begodu ifikelela abenzi beenqunto ngesikhathi sangempela.
businessTransformation.sec4Subtext: Lokha iinsetjenziswa zebhizinisi nazikhulumisana ngaphandle komthungo, idatha iyalisa ukuba mkhiqizo wokubika begodu iba mtjhayeli omkhulu wokusebenza msinyana.
businessTransformation.sec5Subtext: Umbono opheleleko weendawo eziqakathekileko zethekhnoloji ezakha isisekelo sebhizinisi sesimanjemanje, esilinganisekako.
businessTransformation.sec6Subtext: Ukuthuthukisa ukwakheka kwesicelo nokuhlanganisa idatha ehlukanisiweko kuletha ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalako kokusebenza kiyo yoke ihlangano.
businessTransformation.ctaDescription:
Hlola bona ukwakhiwa kwesicelo sesimanjemanje, idatha exhumeneko kanye nethekhnoloji elinganisekako kungasiza njani iinhlangano ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kuhle nokulungiselela ukukhula kwesikhathi esizako.
Khuluma neengcwethi zethu
businessTransformation.sec1P1: Endaweni ejayelekileko yamabhizinisi, ukukhula kuvamise ukuletha iinzukulwana ezinengi zesofthiwe. Izezimali, indlela yokuphakela, isevisi yamakhasimende, nemisebenzi yesimu kanengi isebenza ngeenqhema zesofthiwe ezihlukileko ezitholwe nofana ezakhiwe ngeenkhathi ezihlukileko. Eminyakeni yokuziphendukela kwemvelo, amasistimu la athuthukisa amafomethi wawo wedatha, avuselela ama-cadences, kanye nama-quirks wokuhlanganisa.
businessTransformation.sec1P2: Ukutjhayisana kubonakala kiyo yoke ibhizinisi ngokusebenzisa iinqabo ezijayelekileko zokusebenza:

sec1List.text: ezitlhoga ukufakwa kwedatha okuphindwe kabili nokutjho ngesandla.
ukusebenza ngaphandle kokubusa okuhlangeneko nofana amarekhodi amakhulu ahlangeneko.
, lapho amathimu wokuhlaziya asebenzisa amalanga ahlanganisa izinto ezithunyelwa ngaphandle kunokobana aveze imininingwana.
kiyo yoke iminyango, okwenza iimpendulo eziphikisanako zemibuzo eqakathekileko yokusebenza.
, njengombana ukuhlobana okubuthakathaka kwephuzu ukuya kwephuzu kuzabalaza ukusekela amavolumu wokuthengiselana akhulako.

businessTransformation.sec1P3: Ukuqalana neentjhijilo lezi kutlhoga ukuqala ubujamo bethekhnoloji ingasi njengeqoqo lokuthengwa kwesofthiwe ehlukileko, kodwana njengepulatifomu yebhizinisi ehlangeneko eyenzelwe ukusekela ukushesha kwamaqhinga.

sec2Cards.title: Idatha Silos
sec2Cards.desc: Idatha eqakathekileko yamakhasimende, yezezimali, neyezinto ezikhona ihlala ivaleleke emapulatifomu womnyango, ivimbela umbono owodwa ohlangeneko wokusebenza kwebhizinisi.

sec2Cards.title: Izikhala zokuhlanganisa
sec2Cards.desc: Ukuxhumana kwephuzu-kuya-phuzu kanye nokukhishwa kwe-batch ebusuku kwenza ukulibaziseka, amazinga aphezulu wokuhluleka, kanye neendleko zokulondoloza ezibizako kiwo woke amathimu wokusebenza.

sec2Cards.title: Ilwazi elilibazisekileko
sec2Cards.desc: Lokha abaphathi nakufuze balinde amalanga ukubuyisana kokuphela kwenyanga ukuzwisisa ukusebenza, ukwenza iinqunto kwenziwa ngokusabela kunokobana kubikezele.

businessTransformation.sec3P1: Indlela yesimanjemanje yokwakhiwa kwesicelo ithatha indawo yokuthintana okubuthakathaka kwephuzu ukuya kwephuzu ngesisekelo esisheshayo, esingahlanganisiwe. Ngokusungula i-API eqinileko kanye nesendlalelo sokuhlanganisa, amahlelo asebenzisana ngokusebenzisa iindawo ezilawulwako, ezivikelekileko lokha nakulondolozwa ukuzijamela kwamayunithi webhizinisi ngalinye.
businessTransformation.sec3P2: Amakghono wezobuchwepheshe aqakathekileko wokutjhuguluka kwezakhiwo afaka hlangana:

sec3List.text: Ukuhlukanisa umqondo omkhulu webhizinisi ube ziinkonzo ezilinganisekako.
Ukusungula iinsetjenziswa ezijayelekileko, ezitlolwe phasi zokusebenzisana kwangaphakathi nokusebenzisana kwabalingani.
Ukuhlanganisa amapayipi wedatha yokusebenza ngokuthuthukisa imibuzo ephezulu.
Ukusebenzisa i-telemetry ehlanganisiweko, iindlela zokuhlola, kanye nezilawuli zokufinyelela ezisekelwe endimeni kizo zoke iinkonzo.

businessTransformation.sec4P1: Iinsekelo zedatha ezihlanganisiweko zitjhugulula indlela uburholi namathimu wokusebenza asebenzisana ngayo nelwazi. Kunokobana bathembele emibikweni ebuyela emuva etjengisa ukuthi kwenzekeni emavikini adlulileko, iinhlangano zithola i-telemetry yokusebenza ebukhoma kiwo woke amayunithi webhizinisi.
businessTransformation.sec4P2: Idatha ehlangeneko nokuhlaziywa kusekela imiphumela yebhizinisi esimeme ngokusebenzisa:

sec4List.text: Ukutjhaphuluka okuragela phambili kizo zoke iinthengiso, izinto ezikhona, ukuzaliseka, nokusebenza kwezezimali.
Ukuhlanganiswa kwedatha ngokufunwa okuqeda amaspredishithi wesandla aphindaphindwako.
Iinhlathululo ezilodwa zamamethrikhi afana nomkhawulo, inani lesikhathi sokuphila kwekhasimende, kanye nebelo lokurhola.
Ukutholwa kwephetheni yokubikezela okuveza ubungozi namathuba ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
Isenzo sesikhulu esiqinisekako esisekelwa mhlobo wedatha eqinisekisiweko nokutjhaphuluka.

artificialIntelligence.ctaHeading:
Hlola amathuba we-AI webhizinisi lakho
Thola bona ukuzenzakalela okuhlakaniphileko, abasebenzisani bamabhizinisi kanye namamodeli wokubikezela angavula njani ukusebenza kuhle kizo zoke iinhlelo zakho eziqakathekileko.
artificialIntelligence.ctaDescription: Thola bona ukuzenzakalela okuhlakaniphileko, abaphathi bamabhizinisi kanye namamodeli wokubikezela angavula njani ukusebenza kuhle kizo zoke iinhlelo zakho eziqakathekileko.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Iminyaka eminengi, ubuhlakani bokufakelwa bezamabhizinisi bebuthathwa njengekghono langaphandle: imodeli ebandulwe yodwa, ukutjengiswa kwebhokisi lesihlabathi, nofana i-chatbot ehlukileko efinyeleleka nge-portal ehlukileko. Namhlanjesi, ipharadeyisi itjhuguluke khulu. I-AI yamabhizinisi enomthelela omkhulu ifakwe ngqo ngaphakathi kweenhlelo zokurekhoda—ama-ERP, ama-CRM, amapulatifomu wemali yabantu, kanye neenjini zokuphakela lapho ibhizinisi lamambala lenzeka khona.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P2: Lokha ubuhlakani busebenza ngaphakathi kwehlelo lokurekhoda, buzuza imingcele yezokuphepha ebekwe yinhlangano, amamodeli wedatha, kanye nomqondo webhizinisi. Akukhiqizi iimpendulo ezijayelekileko kwaphela; isebenza ngama-oda aphilako, ihlathulula amathikithi wokusekelwa avulekileko, ihlanganisa ama-invoyisi wabathengisi, begodu isiza abasebenzi ngaphakathi kweendlela abazisebenzisako qobe langa.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P3: Lokhu kutjhuguluka kususa isofthiwe yamabhizinisi ukusuka kuma-database angasebenziko alindele ukugandeleleka kwabantu ukuya kumaplatifomu asebenzako aqale phambili iindingo, enze amagadango ngokuzenzakalelako, begodu aveze iimphakamiso ezifike ngesikhathi.
artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: I-Traditional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) iphumelele khulu ekukhuhleni isikrini ngokuzikhethela, okuphindaphindiweko. Kodwana, imithetho eqinileko iyaphuka nanyana kunini lokha ifomu nayitjhugulukako, nakufika ukuhleleka kwedokhumenti okungakalindelwa, nofana nakuvela into engakajayeleki. Ukuzenzakalela okuhlakaniphileko kuvala lokhu kuhlukana ngokuhlanganisa ukucabanga okucabangako nokusebenza kokuthengiselana:

sec2List.text: Ukuhlela imisebenzi ehlangahlangeneko hlangana neminyango, ukuthumela imisebenzi ngokuya ngokurhaba kanye neendlela zokurarulula zomlando.
Ukuthatha ama-PDF angakahleleki, ama-imeyili, ama-manifest wokuthumela, kanye neenkontileka, ukuziguqula zibe ziinthengiselwano ezihlelekileko zedathabheyisi.
Ukwenza ngokuzenzakalelako ukuqinisekiswa kokusebenza okunamagadango amanengi—okufana nokumadanisa ama-oda wokuthenga ngokujamelana namarisidi neentatimende zebhanga.
Ukuhlaziya amalogi wenqubo ngokuragela phambili ukukhomba iinqabo zesikhathi somjikelezo nokuncoma ukulungiswa komsebenzi.

artificialIntelligence.sec4P1: Nanyana amamodeli wokukhiqiza aphuma phambili ekuzwisiseni nokuhlanganisa ilimi, ubuhlakani bokubikezela budzimelele emaphetheni weembalo afihlekileko ngaphakathi kwamasethi wedatha webhizinisi ahlelekileko. Amamodeli wokubikezela afakwe ngaphakathi anikela iinhlangano amandla wokuqala iinqabo zokusebenza ngaphambi kobana ziphazamise imisebenzi:

modernErp.sec1Subtext: I-ERP akusese yi-accounting yangemuva kwaphela. Yimodeli yokusebenza yebhizinisi yesimanjemanje evezwe ngesofthiwe.
modernErp.sec2Subtext: Inani lamambala lehlangano livela lokha imisebenzi eqakathekileko yebhizinisi nayithengiselana ndawonye ngesisekelo sedijithali esabelwana ngaso.
modernErp.sec3Subtext: Ukubhidliza amaboda wokuthintana hlangana neminyango ukwenzela bona kube nokusebenza okuhle, okuvumelanako.
modernErp.sec4Subtext: Ukuhlanganisa amamethrikhi wokusebenza abe madeshibhodi aphathekako atjengisa ubujamo bamabhizinisi bamanje.
modernErp.sec5Subtext: Iimfanelo zokwakha ezihlukanisa amapulatifomu we-ERP wesimanjemanje ukusuka ekufakweni okuqinileko.
modernErp.sec6Subtext: Ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yebhizinisi eqakathekileko ibe yisisekelo sedijithali esihlangeneko kuveza ukuqina kwehlangano okulinganisekako.
modernErp.ctaHeading: Yenza Imisebenzi Yakho Yebhizinisi Ibe Yesimanjemanje
modernErp.ctaDescription: Hlola bona amapulatifomu we-ERP wesimanjemanje ahlanganisa njani imali, ukuthenga, ukuphakelwa kwepahla kanye nemisebenzi yamabhizinisi ngesisekelo sedijithali esihlangeneko.
modernErp.sec1P1: Eendaweni zamabhizinisi ezitjhuguluka msinyana, amahlelo wokuhlela iinsetjenziswa zamabhizinisi wesintu avamise ukutshwenyeka. Yakhiwa ngesikhathi sokucubungula ngeqoqo kanye namaseva wendawo ahlukanisiweko, ama-ERP wesikhathi esidlulileko bekalungiswe khulu, kubudisi ukuwathuthukisa, begodu angakhanyi kuhle. Imisebenzi yamabhizinisi eqakathekileko beyisebenza ngendlela efanako, ithembele ekuthengiseni ngaphandle ebusuku ukuvumelanisa ama-ledger nama-warehouse.
modernErp.sec1P2: I-ERP yesimanjemanje, yamafu ihlathulula kabutjha lokhu okuguquguqukako. Isebenza njengomgogodla wedijithali ohlangeneko webhizinisi—isisekelo esiphilako lapho ezezimali, ukuthenga, ukusabalalisa, ukutholakala, kanye nemithombo yabantu kuthengiselana ngemodeli yedatha ehlanganyelweko.
modernErp.sec1P3: Ngokuletha imisebenzi eqakathekileko endaweni yinye evumelanako, i-ERP yesimanjemanje isusa amabala angaboniko wokusebenza aphungula ukukhula, okwenza bona abadosiphambili bakghone ukulawula ibhizinisi ngokusebenzisa amatshwayo wesikhathi sangempela kunokobana basebenzise iinrhunyezo zomlando ezidala.
modernErp.sec3P1: Ama-silo asebenzako akakavami ukuba ziinkinga zabantu; ziinkinga zokwakha. Lokha amathimu wokusebenzela amakhasimende, ukuthenga, kanye newendawo yokugcina izinto asebenza eensetjenzisweni ezingahlanganiswako, woke umnikelo udinga ama-imeyili wesandla, amaspredishithi, kanye nezingcingo. Amaphutha ayanda, ama-invoyisi ayabanjwa, begodu ukuzibophelela kwamakhasimende kuyehla.
modernErp.sec3P2: I-ERP yesimanje iqalana nalokhu ngokusebenzisa idatha ehlangeneko nokuhlela ikambiso eqhutshwa mcimbi:

sec3List.text: Lokha i-oda lekhasimende nalifakwako, i-inventory iyabekelwa ngokuzenzakalelako, amalebula wokuthumela akhiqizwa, begodu ama-ledger wokubhadela ayavuselelwa khonokho.
Ama-oda wokuthenga, amarisidi wepahla, kanye nama-invoyisi womthengisi ahambelana ngokuzenzakalelayo nokubuyisana kweendlela ezintathu, atjengisa kwaphela ukubuyekezwa kwabantu.
Amaphepha wesikhathi wephrojekthi, ukwabiwa kwemiholo, kanye neendleko eziqondileko zokusebenza zivezwa ngqo emazingeni weendleko ngesikhathi sangempela.

modernErp.sec4P1: Ukusebenzisa ibhizinisi ngaphandle kokubonakala okuhlangeneko kufana nokundiza enkungwini eminyeneko ngeensetjenziswa ezilibazisekileko. I-ERP yesimanje inikela nge-telemetry yesikhathi sangempela kiyo yoke imikhakha yebhizinisi:

sec4List.text: Ukubukwa kwamsinyana kwamajini woke, ukugeleza kwemali yokusebenza, izikwelede ezivulekileko, kanye nokusalela emuva kwama-oda ngaphandle kokulinda ukuvalwa kokuphela kwesikhathi.
Iinhloko zeminyango zingakha imibuzo ekhethekileko begodu zihlolisise ukusuka eemfinyezweni ezisezingeni lamabhizinisi ukuya eentweni zomugqa wokuthengiselana ngamunye.
Ukuqeda amanani aphikisanako ngokusungula idatha eyodwa elawulwako yamakhasimende, abathengisi, kanye namakhathalogu wemikhiqizo.
Izexwayiso ezizenzakalelayo zazisa abaphathi khonokho lokha amamargini nawehla ngaphasi komkhawulo, i-inventory iphelelwa mamandla, nofana ukulethwa kwabathengisi kuyehla.

cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Njengombana iinhlangano zesimanjemanje zihlanganisa iinsetjenziswa ezinengi, iindawo zamafu, abasebenzi abakude, amadivayisi weselula, nabalingani beqembu lesithathu, umkhawulo wezokuphepha wesintu uyaphela.
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Ukuzivikela okuqakathekileko okuvikela umthangalasiseko oqakathekileko, idatha yenkampani ebucayi, kanye neenhlelo zokusebenza.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: Ubunikazi mtjhini wokulawula wesimanjemanje. Pheze koke ukwephulwa kwezokuphepha okukhulu kuthoma ngokuqinisekisa okusengozini kunokobana kusetjenziswe isofthiwe.
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: I-Zero Trust akusiwo umkhiqizo owodwa nofana ithulusi. Liqhinga lokwakha elisekelwe emthethweni oqondileko: ungathembi into ngaphakathi nofana ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi ngokuzenzakalelayo.
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Ukuvikela imithwalo yomsebenzi kiwo woke amafu womphakathi, izakhiwo ezihlangeneko, kanye neendawo ezisabalalisiweko.
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Ukujamelana kwe-inthanethi kwamambala kwamukela bona izehlakalo zingenzeka. Ukuzilungiselela kugxile ekuvinjweni okusheshayo, ukuphazamiseka okuncane kwebhizinisi, nokuvuselelwa okuqinisekisiwe.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Ukwakha ibhizinisi elijamelana ne-inthanethi kuvikela inani lenhlangano, ukuma kokulawula, kanye nedumela lemakethe.
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Hlola bona iinhlangano zingaqinisa njani ukuphepha, zivikele amahlelo aqakathekileko begodu zilungiselele iinsongo kizo zoke iindawo ezihlangeneko.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: Ngesikhathi se-IT yamabhizinisi, ukuphepha bekusebenza ngokwemfundiso ye-castle-and-moat: yoke into engaphakathi kwenethiwekhi yama-ofisi wenkampani beyithathwa njengethenjwako, kuthi yoke into engaphandle beyithathwa njengengathenjwako. I-firewall eyodwa yenkampani ivikele amaseva wangaphakathi, ama-database, namakhomphyutha wedeskithophu.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Ibhizinisi lanamhlanjesi sele likhule khulu. Imithwalo yomsebenzi ihlala eendaweni ezinengi (i-AWS, i-Azure, i-GCP), abasebenzi bafikelela iinsetjenziswa zebhizinisi ezivela eendaweni ezihlukahlukeneko, begodu ama-API aragela phambili nokutjhentjhana ngedatha yokusebenza ebucayi nabahlinzeki bangaphandle, iinkhungo zezezimali, nabathengisi be-SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3: Nanyana ukuxhumana okukhulu lokhu kukhuthaza ukutjhagala okukhulu kwebhizinisi, kwandisa khulu indawo yokuhlaselwa kwamabhizinisi. I-API endpoint ngayinye, ithokheni yobunikazi, idivayisi yeselula exhunyiwe, nokuhlanganiswa kwe-SaaS kumele i-vector engaba khona yokuvezwa. Ukuvikelwa kwamabhizinisi kwamambala kutlhoga ukutjhuguluka ukusuka ekuvikelekeni okusekelwe emaphethelweni ukuya ekuvikelekeni okusebenzako, kokuphela kokuphela kwe-inthanethi.

sec2Cards.title: Ukutholwa Kwengozi
sec2Cards.desc: Ubuhlakani bokusongela obusizwa ngokufunda ngomtjhini obuqapha amaphethini wenethiwekhi angakajayeleki, ukusetjenziswa kumbi kobufakazi, kanye nobuthakathaka belanga elingenalutho ngesikhathi sangempela.

sec2Cards.title: Ukugada ukuvikeleka
sec2Cards.desc: I-Centralized Security Operations Center (SOC) i-telemetry ehlobanisa izehlakalo kiwo woke amaseva, amaqoqo wamakhonteyina, abahlinzeki bobunikazi, kanye nama-endpoints.

sec2Cards.title: Ukulawulwa kobungozi
sec2Cards.desc: Ukuskena okuragelako okuzenzakalelayo kobuthakathaka kiyo yoke imithangalasiseko, iindawo zokugcina ikhodi yomthombo, kanye namarejista wamakhonteyina ukulungisa ubuthakathaka ngokuzikhandla.

sec2Cards.title: Ukuvikelwa kwedatha
sec2Cards.desc: Ukubethela okuqinileko ekuthuthweni (TLS 1.3) nasekuphumuleni (AES-256), kanye nokulawulwa kokukhandela ukulahlekelwa kwedatha (DLP) ukukhandela ukuvuza kwepahla yobuhlakani.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: Ukuvikela ipahla yamabhizinisi kutlhoga ukuqinisekisa bona woke umuntu—kungaba mphathi womuntu, usonkontileka wangaphandle, nofana i-akhawundi yesevisi yesofthiwe ezijameleko—inemvumo eqinisekisiweko yeensetjenziswa eziyifinyelelako.

sec3List.text: Ukungena kanye (SSO) kanye namazinga wobunikazi obuhlangeneko aqeda ukugcinwa kwamaphasiwedi ahlukanisiweko kizo zoke iinsetjenziswa.
Iinkinobho ze-FIDO2 ezijamelana nokukhwabanisa kanye neentjhijilo ezisekelwe ebungozini zemisebenzi yokuphatha ebucayi.
Iinlawuli zokufinyelela ezisekelwe endimeni (RBAC) nezisekelwe emfanelweni (ABAC) eziphoqelelwa emazingeni we-API nedathabheyisi.
Ukunikela ngokufinyelela kwesikhatjhana, ngesikhathi esifaneleko (i-JIT) okuphelelwa sikhathi ngokuzenzakalelako lokha imisebenzi yokuphatha nayiphethako.

cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveTitle: Ukuqinisekiswa okuragela phambili phezu kokuthemba okungaboni
cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveLead: Ekwakhiweni kwe-Zero Trust, ukuthembana okungabonakaliko okusekelwe endaweni yenethiwekhi kuyaqedwa ngokupheleleko. Njalo ukuthengiselana, umbuzo wedathabheyisi, nokungena komsebenzisi kufanele kuragele phambili nokufakazela ukusemthethweni kwawo:

cloudSecurityCards.title: Umthwalo owabelwana ngawo
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Ukubusa okucacileko okuhlukanisa ukuvikeleka kwesakhiwo esibonakalako somhlinzeki wefu ukusuka emthwalweni webhizinisi wokubethela idatha, imigomo ye-IAM, kanye nekhodi yesicelo.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Ingqalasizinda njengekhodi (IaC)
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Ukuhlelwa kwamafu okungatjhugulukiko, okuhlolwako kulawulwa ngekhodi. Iimskena ezizenzakalelayo zomthethomgomo njengekhodi zivimbela ukuhlelwa okungakalungi kanye namabhakede avulekileko ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Isitja & Ukuvikeleka kwe-Kubernetes
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Isikhathi sokugijima sekhonteyina esiqinileko, amarejista weenthombe atlikitliweko, ukuhlukaniswa okuncani kwenethiwekhi, nokulawulwa kwemfihlo okuzenzakalelayo okugcina iimfihlo zingangeni eendaweni zokugcina umthombo.

cloudModernization.title: Ukuthuthukisa iinsetjenziswa ezidala zefu
cloudModernization.subtitle: Hlola indlela esebenzako yokuhlola, ukwenza ibe yesimanjemanje nokuthuthela iinsetjenziswa zakade ukuya ezakhiweni zamafu ezivikelekileko.
cloudModernization.imageCaption: Umbono weThekhnoloji yamaBhizinisi — Ukubuyiselwa kwepulatifomu ye-Cloud-Native & Ukufaka iinkhonteyina

modernizationApproaches.title: Ukubamba kabutjha (Phakamisa nokuTjhugulula)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Ukutjhugulula imithwalo yomsebenzi ukuya emitjhini ebonakalako yamafu msinyana ngokutjhugululwa okuncani kwekhodi.

modernizationApproaches.title: Ipulatifomu kabutjha (Phakamisa nokubumba kabutjha)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Thuthukisa iinhlaka zesikhathi sokusebenza, yamukela ama-database wamafu alawulwako, begodu wenze imisebenzi ibe lula.

modernizationApproaches.title: Refactor (Ukwakhiwa kabutjha kwe-Cloud-Native)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Hlukanisa ama-monoliths abe ma-microservices ahlanganisiweko kanye nama-API angenaseva aqhutshwa mcimbi.

modernizationApproaches.title: Faka esikhundleni (SaaS Modernization)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Tjheja iinhlelo zefa ezingasebenziko ukusebenzisa isofthiwe yamafu wamabhizinisi eyakhelwe umnqopho.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Ukuhlolwa kwelifa
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Ukubekwa kwemephu yokuthembela okuzenzakalelayo, ukutlola isikwelede sezobuchwepheshe, nokulinganisa ukulungela kwefu.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Ukwakhiwa okuqothelweko
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Amapulani we-microservice yamamojula, amathopholoji wekhonteyina, kanye namathempulethi we-IaC azenzekelayo.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Ukufuduka Kwezigaba
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Ukukhishwa kwe-Canary, ukuvumelanisa idatha yokutlola kabili, kanye namagagasi wokusika we-zero-downtime.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Ukulungiswa kwefu
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Ukulawulwa kweendleko okuragela phambili, i-autoscaling telemetry, kanye nokubuyekezwa kokusebenza kwe-FinOps.

cloudModernizationBenefits: Iindleko eziphasi khulu zokulondolozwa kwesakhiwo kanye nokuvuselelwa kwe-hardware
Ukuthamba kwekhomphyutha okuseduze nokungapheliko okuphatha ithrafikhi ephezulu yamabhizinisi ngaphandle kokulibaziseka okungekho
Ijubane lokukhipha elirhabako ngamapayipi wokuthunyelwa we-CI/CD azenzekelayo
Ukuqedwa kwamaphuzu wefa wokubhalelwa ngokutholakala kwama-AZ amanengi
Izakhiwo ze-API zesimanjemanje ezivumela ukuhlanganiswa okurhabako kwabalingani beenpulatifomu ezihlukahlukeneko
Ukutjhejwa kwesikhathi sangempela okuthuthukisiweko ekusebenzeni kwesicelo nokusetjenziswa kwemali emafini
landscapeAssessmentPoints: Ukubeka imephu yokuthembela okuyinkimbinkimbi phakathi kwezicelo kanye nokuvumelanisa idatha
Ukukhomba ukuhlelwa kwebhoduluko okuqinileko kanye nama-schema wedathabheyisi yomnikazi
Ukuhlola ukuthobela imithetho kanye nemikhawulo yokuzibusa kwedatha ngokwendawo
Ukubala iindleko ezipheleleko zobunikazi (i-TCO) kizo zoke iindlela zokuvuselela nokubuyisela
Ukusungula amagagasi acacileko wokukhiqiza ukuvikela imisebenzi yamabhizinisi yangelanga
cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Ama-monoliths agugileko avimbela ibelo lokusungula, akhuphula ubuthakathaka bokusebenza, begodu akhuphule iindleko zokulondolozwa kwesakhiwo.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Ukuthuthukiswa kwefu okuphumelelako kuthoma ngokuhlola okuqinileko. Ukugxuma ngqo ekufudukeni ngaphandle kokuhlola ukuthembela kwesicelo kuyimbangela eyinhloko yokulibaziseka kokusika.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Alikho iqhinga lokufuduka elifanako. Amabhizinisi adosa phambili afanisa iphetheni elungileko yokuthuthukisa umthwalo womsebenzi ngamunye ngokuya ngenani lebhizinisi, ukurhaba, kanye nesikolodo sezobuchwepheshe.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Indlela ehlelekileko etjhugulula ama-monolith wefa abe ziinkonzo zamafu eziqinileko, ezivikelekileko nezigcinekako.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Ukuthuthela iinkambo zakade ezakhiweni zamafu zesimanjemanje kuletha ukusebenza okuphathekako nokubikezela iindleko.
cloudModernization.ctaHeading: Yenza iinsetjenziswa zakho ezidala zibe zesimanjemanje
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Hlola indlela esebenzako yokuhlola, ukwenza ibe yesimanjemanje nokuthuthela iinsetjenziswa zakade ukuya ezakhiweni zamafu ezivikelekileko.
cloudModernization.sec1P1: Iinsetjenziswa eziqakathekileko ezakhiwe eminyakeni elitjhumi eyadlulako zisadosa amabhiliyoni wemali yamabhizinisi, kodwana ukuqina kwazo kwezakhiwo kudala ubungozi obukhulako bokusebenza.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Ibhizinisi ngalinye liqalene nokungezwani hlangana nokuzinza nokuthuthukiswa kwesimanjemanje. Iinhlelo zakade zenzelwe ukuhlala isikhathi eside, begodu zisebenze kuhle iminyaka eminengi. Kodwana, njengombana iimfuneko zebhizinisi zikhula msinyana, izakhiwo ezidala zihlangabezana nemikhawulo yesakhiwo:

sec1List.text: Amakhodi we-monolithic akhiwe phezu kwamafreyimu angasebenziko anamadamu wethalenta anciphako atholakalako wokutlhogonyelwa.
Iingcenye ezihlangeneko lapho ukutjhugulula isici sinye kubeka engozini yokuphula amamojula wokusebenza angahlobene.
Imikhawulo yokulinganisa ejame ngqo edinga ukuthenga i-hardware ebizako ukusingatha ukunyuka kwethrafikhi yesikhathi sonyaka.
Ukungakghoni ukusebenzisana kuhle nama-app weselula wesimanjemanje, ama-portal wamakhasimende, nofana ama-API womlingani ngaphandle kwamaskripthi we-batch abuthakathaka.
Imijikelezo yokuphila yegumbi leseva ebonakalako, ubuthakathaka bokusekela, kanye neendleko eziphezulu zamandla/zokupholisa.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Ikhambo lokuthuthukisa elisebenzako lithoma ngokusungula ukucaciswa okupheleleko kiyo yoke indawo ekhona:

sec2List.text: Ukutlola yoke imithwalo yomsebenzi esebenzako, amamojula wesintu, imitlolo yangemuva, kanye namaphakheji weqembu lesithathu.
Ukubeka imephu yokuhlanganiswa kwesikhathi sokusebenza okuyinkimbinkimbi, amatafula wedathabheyisi ahlanganyelweko, ukubiza ihlelo lamafayela eliqondileko, kanye neenkontileka zesevisi zangaphandle.
Ukuhlola izakhiwo zedatha, iimfuneko zobuqotho bokuthengiselana, i-cadence yokusekela, nemithetho yokulawula.
Ukuhlola i-CPU, imemori, ukusetjenziswa kwesitoreji, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwenethiwekhi ukuya ekucacisweni kwefu eliqothelweko.
Ukuhlukanisa iinsetjenziswa zibe ziingaba ukuklama amagagasi wokufuduka aphephileko, ahlelekileko aneenkambiso ezicacileko zokubuyela emuva.

cloudModernization.cloudArchitectureTitle: Ukugeleza kwesimanjemanje kwefu ukusuka ekupheleni ukuya ekupheleni
cloudModernization.sec4P1: Indlela yokwakhiwa kwendawo eya kiyo ihlukanisa iinsetjenziswa eziqakathekileko zibe ziinkonzo ezimamojula, ezifakwe emakhonteni ezibanjwe kumapulatifomu we-elastic cloud (njenge-Kubernetes nofana ama-runtimes alawulwako angenaseva).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Ngokusungula amapayipi wokuthunyelwa kwe-CI/CD okuzenzakalelayo, ukusika okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okuzenzakalelayo, kanye nesakhiwo njengekhodi, ukuthunyelwa kutjhuguluka kusuka emicimbini yempelaveke ephazamisa imizwa ibe yimikhuba yangelanga engapheliko.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: I-elastic compute ikhula ngokuzenzakalelayo ngesikhathi sokukhuphuka kweemfuno bese yehla ngesikhathi sokuphumula, kuqeda iindleko zemithombo engasebenziko ngesikhathi kuqinisekiswa isikhathi sokuphendula esingaphasi kwemizuzwana yabasebenzisi bephasi loke.
cloudModernization.keyPerspectiveLead: Isipiliyoni sitjengisa bona amaphrojekthi wesimanjemanje ayaphumelela lokha nakasekelwa ekulungiseleleni okupheleleko, ukulandelana kwamagagasi okucacileko, nokuhlolwa okuqinileko:
